newsitem.title: FINLAND: Outokumpu wins copper concentrator order.
newsitem.headline: Outokumpu wins copper concentrator order.

text.p: Finnish mining and metals group Outokumpu Oy said in a statement on Friday it won an order worth $15.7 million to supply a copper concentrator to Chilean Compania Minera Zaldivar.
The agreement covers engineering, equipment deliveries, construction and installations of the flotation, thickening and filtering plants, Outokumpu said.
The start-up was scheduled for end-1997, it said.

Compania Minera Zaldivar is a mine and hydrometallurgical copper cathode production plant in northern Chile jointly owned by Outokumpu and Canadian mining company Placer Dome Inc . It is scheduled to reach full capacity, 125,000 tonnes per year, during the latter half of 1997, Outokumpu said. --Helsinki newsroom +358-9-680 50 245, e-mail news@reuters.fi
